name: Light Dal Makhani
ingredients: ½ cup (100 g) whole black urad dal (sabut urad), soaked overnight
1 tbsp each minced ginger and garlic
½ tsp each Kashmiri chilli powder and garam masala
steps: Pressure-cook the urad and rajma with 3 cups water and salt for 35–40 minutes until completely soft and mashable.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger and garlic for 6 minutes.
Add the tomato purée and chilli powder and cook for 8 minutes until thick.
Add the cooked dal with its liquid and simmer for 15 minutes, mashing some of the dal against the pot to thicken.
Stir in the soy milk, garam masala and kasuri methi. Simmer 3 minutes.
note: Slow simmering gives the creamy texture; no butter or cream is used. Soak the dal overnight and discard the soaking water.
